name: feature-flag-percentage-rollout-p4
prompt: how do I roll a new feature out to a stable random percentage of users and ramp it up gradually

chunks.content: every flag change is recorded with who made it and when
subscription renewals are charged at midnight UTC on the renewal date
the settings toggle switch now has an accessible focus ring
the dashboard reads from a denormalized summary table refreshed every minute
the promo engine applies a 15 percent discount to the cart total when a valid coupon is entered at checkout
the campaign report shows the open rate as a percentage and ranks subject lines by how many users opened them
decided to bucket each user by hashing their stable user id with the flag name into 0-99, so the same user always lands in the same bucket and the on/off decision is sticky across requests
each rollout has a kill switch that forces the flag to zero percent instantly if error rates climb, overriding the gradual ramp
we keep an allow-list of specific users and internal accounts that always see the feature regardless of their percentage bucket, for dogfooding
to ramp, we raise the enabled threshold from 1 to 5 to 25 percent over a few days, and because bucketing is deterministic nobody who already had it flips back off as we widen it
the calendar's first day of week follows the user's locale
the ops dashboard graphs request rate, error rate, and latency side by side
the consent screen now itemizes each requested scope
added a synonym list so 'laptop' also matches 'notebook'
